capabilities: Preview a note as PDF pages with live option updates
Save the PDF to a chosen location or next to the note
Print the note through the system print dialog
Configure paper size, orientation, margins, text size, page and line numbers
Preserve empty lines and indentation from the editor in the PDF
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); works offline with no network use. Reading-view empty-line and indentation options were split into a companion plugin, Editor-like Reading View. Builds on Obsidian's own PDF rendering (light theme, CSS snippets, plugin styles).
problem: Obsidian's PDF export gives no page preview and collapses repeated empty lines, so users cannot check or control the printed layout beforehand.
summary: PDF export tool that previews a note as PDF pages before saving, with paper, margin, text size and colour options, and prints it.
